prompt:
Rewrite the snippet snippets/b2b-quantity-minimum.liquid so that it renders a wholesale quantity-tier table. Inputs (all top-level variables, there is no section object): - tiers: array, possibly empty. Each item is an object with min_qty (integer >= 1, never null) and price (string, never null). Tiers are already sorted by ascending min_qty, and the values are distinct. - unit_label: string or null. Rules: - LABEL is the HTML-escaped unit_label. If unit_label is null or the empty string, LABEL is `units`. - If tiers is empty, output nothing (empty string). - Otherwise output exactly this, with no whitespace or newlines between tags:

Minimum order: FIRSTMIN LABEL

    ROWS
FIRSTMIN is the min_qty of the first tier. - ROWS contains one row per tier, in order: RANGE PRICE - There is a single space between the two spans. - PRICE is the HTML-escaped price. - CLASS is set as follows: - If the tier is both first and last (only one tier), CLASS is ` class="b2b-min__base b2b-min__top"`. - Otherwise the first tier gets ` class="b2b-min__base"` and the last tier gets ` class="b2b-min__top"`. - Middle tiers have no class attribute at all. - RANGE is computed as follows: - For the last tier, RANGE is `MIN+ LABEL` (for example `100+ units`). - For every other tier, let UPPER be the next tier's min_qty minus 1. If UPPER equals this tier's min_qty, RANGE is `MIN LABEL`. Otherwise RANGE is `MIN–UPPER LABEL`, using an en dash (–) with no spaces around it, for example `10–49 units`. - Escape with the core escape filter, so & < > " ' become & < > " '. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/b2b-quantity-minimum.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
